One loader branch (the format is sniffed by tools/model-lodhod.py already) and the NQ E row would have a corpus.

Agenda item 3 — a patch-build tier? Updates are slow because every build re-runs the whole suite (167 files) and ships the whole tree; a patch tier would ship the panel alone with the touched harnesses. His yes / no (operator, 2026-09-08: 'making updates is very slow. is there a lot of unused code…' — measured: no; the time is the suite and the installer).
